summary: Tested Family Games System (Feature A) — both backend (17/17 pytest pass) and frontend Playwright flows (parent + student). Backend endpoints, validation, role-based visibility, approve/reject, and delete rules all behave per spec. Frontend nav, catalog, parent pack editor (create + edit), pending tab (approve/reject), student studio (locked + unlocked), kid-submit, and play-with-packId all work. Found one UX bug: kid's just-submitted pending pack does not appear under 'Your packs' in Kid Studio (Waiting chip never shows) because the backend list endpoint filters students to status=approved.

minor.issue: Filter restricts to status='approved' for ALL packs including the student's own. Spec says creator-kid should see their pending pack with a 'Waiting' chip — currently the pack disappears from KidStudio 'Your packs' until parent approves. Recommend allowing {created_by_user_id == user.id} regardless of status (kid sees own pending/rejected) while still hiding sibling non-approved.

ui_bugs.issue: Pending pack just submitted by the kid does not appear in 'Your packs', so the 'Waiting' chip flow described in the spec is unobservable. Toast 'Pack sent to your grown-up for a thumbs-up!' does fire, and the pack does land in the parent's Pending tab — so the data is saved correctly; only the kid-side list is missing it.

action_items: Allow student GET /api/game-packs to also return the student's OWN packs in pending/rejected status (currently only approved are returned). Keep sibling visibility restricted to approved. This will make KidStudio 'Your packs' show the just-submitted pack with a 'Waiting' chip, matching the spec.

Optional: doc-align — the test-id list in the review mentions 'sentence-input-{i}' as a Kid Studio testid, but KidStudio.jsx actually uses 'kid-sent-{i}' (and 'kid-pair-word/meaning-{i}', 'kid-mem-{i}'). Either fine, but update the testid list to avoid confusion for future testers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_game_packs: students cannot see their own non-approved packs — breaks the 'Waiting' UX contract.

server.py _validate_pack_content for memory_cards truncates items at 8 chars (`[:8]`). Long emoji or accented chars could be split; consider using grapheme-aware length or character count instead of byte slice if multi-codepoint emojis are expected.

server.py `get_game_pack` returns 403 for a student fetching their OWN pending pack (status != 'approved' short-circuits before owner check). If KidStudio ever wants to deep-link to a pending pack for the creator, this will block it.
GamePack.creator_name is freely stored from user.name without sanitization; minor XSS surface if rendered without escaping (React escapes by default — OK, but worth a note).
Front-end ParentPackEditor uses /games redirect with `replace` — good. No loading skeleton on initial fetch; minor UX nit.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (one UX bug; all other flows pass)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed packs during runs; all cleaned up at end of UI test. Threshold restored to 7 at end of test. Pre-existing 'Animals' (Word Match) and 'My pack' (Sentence Builder, approved) packs from prior smoke test were preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is in /app/backend/tests/test_family_games.py and is fully self-contained (creates+cleans up). It mutates the demo student's game_studio_unlock_streak during the locked/unlocked test and restores to 7 at the end. If the parent-side list test fails with 'approved not in statuses', another test may have already cleaned up packs — re-run the suite from scratch. The frontend bug requires backend change to truly fix.
rca of the issue: BUG: KidStudio 'Your packs' missing Waiting chip after kid submits a pack. ROOT CAUSE: server.py GET /api/game-packs filters {status: 'approved'} unconditionally for students, so the kid's own pending pack is excluded. REPRODUCTION: (1) login parent, set student threshold to 1 via PUT /api/students/{id}/intake, (2) login student@demo.com, go to /student/studio, (3) tap 'New pack', create any pack, submit -> toast appears but 'Your packs' below remains empty/unchanged. FIX: change the student branch of list_game_packs to OR-in {created_by_user_id == user.id} without the approved gate (or split into two queries: own packs any status + sibling/parent packs approved-only).
